register_sales_tax.title: Register for Tennessee Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: If you have physical nexus (FBA inventory) or economic nexus ($100,000 (direct sales only; marketplace excluded)) in Tennessee, registration is required.

steps.title: Register with Tennessee DOR
steps.detail: Apply as a remote seller. Threshold: $100,000 (direct sales only; marketplace excluded). FBA inventory likely creates nexus (majority rule; no specific carve-out found).
steps.verification_check: Receive a Tennessee sales tax permit/license number.

steps.title: Note filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Typical: monthly filing. Returns typically due the 20th of the month following the period. Verify assigned frequency after registration.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable TN tax collection in Shopify for direct orders. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Mark TN as registered in the dashboard.

franchise_or_entity.title: Tennessee Franchise & Excise Tax
franchise_or_entity.summary: TN imposes franchise tax (on net worth/property) and excise tax (6.5% on net earnings) on entities doing business in TN. Minimum franchise tax is $100.

steps.title: Review entity-level obligations with CPA
steps.detail: Tennessee franchise & excise tax may apply to entities doing business in TN. The excise tax is on net earnings; franchise tax is on net worth or book value of real/tangible property in TN.

marketplace_facilitator_notes.title: Amazon Marketplace — Tennessee
marketplace_facilitator_notes.summary: Amazon collects and remits TN sales tax on marketplace orders. This does not eliminate registration or filing obligations.

steps.title: Amazon handles sales tax on Amazon orders
steps.detail: You do not owe additional sales tax on Amazon-facilitated orders.

steps.title: Register and file if nexus exists
steps.detail: If you have physical or economic nexus, registration may be required. Returns show Amazon-collected amounts as marketplace deductions.

steps.title: Collect on Shopify/direct
steps.detail: You are responsible for collecting and remitting on direct (Shopify) orders shipped to TN.
